about: Notification pop-ups like Windows 11 toasts: bottom-right corner, 12 px from the screen edge and the taskbar, Windows' width, no line under the app name and no timeout bar, the picture on the left, action buttons filling the row with equal widths, a monochrome close glyph, no KDE settings button and no bell in the tray (the clock opens the notification centre, like Windows 11). Matched against plasma-workspace 6.3.6 (Debian 13).

replacements.why: no line under the app name
replacements.new:
topInset: 0
        background: null // VeltOS: no line under the app name, like Windows
        Layout.fillWidth: true
        Layout.columnSpan: delegateRoot.__firstColumn + 2

replacements.why: no timeout bar under the header
replacements.new: visible: false // VeltOS: Windows toasts have no timeout bar

replacements.old:
Layout.row: 2
        Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn
        Layout.columnSpan: icon.visible ? 1 : 2
        modelInterface: delegateRoot.modelInterface
replacements.new:
Layout.row: 2
        Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn + (icon.visible ? 1 : 0) // VeltOS: picture on the left
        Layout.columnSpan: icon.visible ? 1 : 2
        modelInterface: delegateRoot.modelInterface

replacements.why: picture on the left, like Windows toasts
replacements.new:
Layout.row: 2
        Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn // VeltOS: picture on the left, like Windows
        Layout.rowSpan: 2
        Layout.rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing

Layout.row: summary.visible ? 3 : 2
        Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn + (icon.visible ? 1 : 0) // VeltOS: picture on the left

Layout.row: 4
        Layout.topMargin: Kirigami.Units.largeSpacing // VeltOS
        Layout.column: delegateRoot.__firstColumn

replacements.why: buttons start at the left edge
buttons share the row with equal widths
replacements.new:
Layout.fillWidth: true
                Layout.preferredWidth: 1 // VeltOS: equal widths filling the row, like Windows
                Layout.horizontalStretchFactor: 1

replacements.why: no button opening KDE's notification settings
replacements.new:
icon.name: "configure"
        visible: false // VeltOS: KDE's notification settings dialog is not offered

replacements.why: toasts in the bottom-right corner, like Windows 11
Windows' toast width and distance from the screen edge
replacements.old:
property int popupWidth: (popupLocation & Qt.AlignHCenter) && !Kirigami.Settings.isMobile ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 22 : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 18
    property int popupEdgeDistance: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2
property int popupSpacing: (popupLocation & Qt.AlignHCenter) && !Kirigami.Settings.isMobile ? Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit

replacements.why: no tray icon: the clock opens the notification centre
newest toast at the bottom, older ones move up, like Windows

replacements.new:
id: actionRow
        uniformCellSizes: true // VeltOS: buttons of equal width, like Windows
